comment: Coding-backend bundle manifest. See docs/EXTENDING.md for how backends are selected. v2 (2026-05-04 reconciliation) adds 'distribution' (npm | github_release) + 'npm_package' for npm-distributed CLIs (Cline, Continue, Claude SDK, Gemini CLI). Versions and sha256 placeholders are filled in by scripts/build-coding-cli-manifest.sh at release-build time. Do NOT hand-edit shipped manifests; edit the build helper instead.

goose.comment: Repo moved block/goose -> aaif-goose/goose under AAIF/Linux Foundation. Asset naming uses Rust target triples; Windows uses .zip upstream — build helper substitutes per-platform suffix. Provider auth: NOT GOOSE_PROVIDER_KEY (wyrdsekai invention); upstream Goose reads ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY / GOOGLE_API_KEY directly per provider. Adapter maps coding.backends.goose.provider -> correct env var.

api_key.note: Per-provider: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY / GOOGLE_API_KEY / (none for local). Adapter sets the right env var based on coding.backends.goose.provider; no GOOSE_PROVIDER_KEY indirection.

codex.tos_warning: Subject to OpenAI Usage Policies and pricing

claude-sdk.comment: Distributed via npm @anthropic-ai/claude-code; reuses ClaudeCliInference.java pattern. Headless OAuth: claude login --no-browser (paste-this-URL device flow).

oauth.note: claude login --no-browser is the headless paste-this-URL OAuth flow (code.claude.com/docs/en/headless). Pre-2026-05 the manifest mistakenly marked this false. Existing pattern in core/src/main/java/org/wyrdsekai/core/inference/ClaudeCliInference.java.

gemini-cli.min_version_reason: CVSS-10 RCE; original patches in 0.39.1 / 0.40.0-preview.3, cherry-pick floor v0.40.1 (2026-04-30)

oauth.note: OAuth is browser-only (issue google-gemini/gemini-cli#1696 unresolved as of May 2026). Headless hosts must use API key via GEMINI_API_KEY (or GOOGLE_API_KEY / GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS).

cline.comment: Distributed via npm `cline` (cline.bot/blog/announcing-cline-cli-2-0). GitHub releases publish only the .vsix IDE extension. Headless argv: cline -y "<task>" or cline --json "<task>" with prompt as POSITIONAL.

oauth.note: Browser OAuth via `cline auth` with no args; credential file location is not publicly documented as of May 2026.

api_key.note: Pre-stage credentials via `cline auth -p <provider> -k <key>` OR set the standard provider env var (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY / etc.) — Cline reads them directly. CLINE_PROVIDER_KEY is wyrdsekai's invention and is no longer used.

continue.comment: Distributed via npm @continuedev/cli; binary name `cn`; requires Node.js 20+. Headless argv: cn -p "<prompt>" with prompt as POSITIONAL. Source: docs.continue.dev/cli/quickstart + docs.continue.dev/guides/cli.

oauth.note: First run prompts browser OAuth; no dedicated `cn login` subcommand in current upstream docs (May 2026). Headless hosts can use CONTINUE_API_KEY env var instead.

openhands.comment: Targets V1 Agent Server (OpenHands/software-agent-sdk v1.20.0 May 4 2026). Adapter speaks REST + WebSocket to `openhands-agent-server --port 8000`, NOT JSON-RPC MCP (the MCP shape used pre-2026-05-04 was fabricated). Docker-image tag is the legacy OpenHands/OpenHands runtime image (v1.7.0); V1 SDK Agent Server is typically run via pip install openhands-agent-server, but the docker_image is retained for `wyrd setup openhands` users who want the legacy runtime sandbox.
